name: Kor Anjiliac; (The Bootana Hutta region, with Kor Anjiliac represented by the number 14)
description: Kor Anjiliac was a world located in the Kor Anjiliac system, a part of the Bootana Hutta area in the Hutt Space portion of the Slice. It was connected by a hyperlane to the Huloon and Langoona systems. Kor Anjiliac served as the throneworld of the Anjiliac clan of the Hutt species.
